# mtncloud_mos_bucket (Data Source)

Reads one MOS bucket and all its settings: console record, ACL, CORS and lifecycle rules, access logging and object lock. A setting MOS doesn't support reads as empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Everything about one bucket: console record, ACL, CORS, lifecycle, logging, object lock.
data "mtncloud_mos_bucket" "site" {
  name = "acme-website"
}

output "site_bucket" {
  value = {
    acl             = data.mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.acl
    endpoint        = data.mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.endpoint_url
    lifecycle_rules = length(data.mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.lifecycle_rule)
    logs_go_to      = data.mtncloud_mos_bucket.site.logging_target_bucket
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The bucket's name in MOS.

### Read-Only

- `acl` (String) `private` (only the tenant), `public-read` (anyone may list the bucket), `public-read-write` (anyone may also add and delete objects: rarely wise) or `authenticated-read` (any MOS user may list it).
- `console_id` (String) Its console bucket record's ID (the `mtncloud_mos_bucket` ID), or null when it isn't in the console.
- `console_name` (String) Its name in the console, or null.
- `cors_rule` (Attributes Set) The rules, 1 to 100. Their order has no meaning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors_rule))
- `creation_date` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `default_retention_days` (Number) Days new objects are kept, or null.
- `default_retention_mode` (String) The default retention for new objects (`GOVERNANCE`), or null.
- `default_retention_years` (Number) Years new objects are kept, or null.
- `endpoint_url` (String) The endpoint its console record uses, or null.
- `grants` (List of String) The grants MOS holds, as `<grantee>:<permission>`, for example `AllUsers:READ`.
- `id` (String) The bucket's name.
- `lifecycle_rule` (Attributes Set) The rules, 1 to 1000. Their order has no meaning. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--lifecycle_rule))
- `logging_target_bucket` (String) Where its access logs go, or null when logging is off.
- `logging_target_prefix` (String) The prefix of its access logs' names, or null.
- `object_lock_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the bucket was created with object lock.

<a id="nestedatt--cors_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors_rule`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_headers` (Set of String) Request headers allowed, or `*` for any.
- `allowed_methods` (Set of String) HTTP methods allowed: `GET`, `PUT`, `POST`, `DELETE` or `HEAD`.
- `allowed_origins` (Set of String) Origins allowed, for example `https://app.example.com`, or `*` for any.
- `expose_headers` (Set of String) Response headers the browser may read.
- `id` (String) A name for the rule.
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) How long a browser may cache the answer to a preflight request, 1 to 86400 seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--lifecycle_rule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `lifecycle_rule`

Read-Only:

- `abort_incomplete_upload_days` (Number) Abort uploads still unfinished this many days after they started, freeing their space.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule runs. Defaults to `true`.
- `expiration_date` (String) Delete objects on this date (`YYYY-MM-DD`, at midnight UTC).
- `expiration_days` (Number) Delete objects this many days after they were written.
- `id` (String) The rule's name, unique in the bucket.
- `prefix` (String) The rule covers objects whose names start with this. Unset covers the whole bucket.
